description: Na₂Cd(SiO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two CdO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.48 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.88 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.58 Å. There are three inequivalent Cd sites. In the first Cd site, Cd is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two CdO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Cd-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.52 Å. In the second Cd site, Cd is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent CdO₆ octahedra,  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one CdO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Cd-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.68 Å. In the third Cd site, Cd is bonded to six O atoms to form CdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent CdO₆ octahedra,  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one CdO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Cd-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.37 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CdO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-78°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CdO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-55°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.66 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two CdO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-52°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two CdO₆ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-74°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.68 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three Cd, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two Cd, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Cd, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Cd and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Si atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Cd, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Cd, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two Cd, and one Si atom.
